items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He might – he’d go with any suggestion I make. Everything I say, he’d say, “Yeah.” Because I remember he recorded my tune, Shades of Light, with him – with McCoy.

ctx.x: Which piano players were you listening to?
Let’s see. One time it was McCoy Tyner. The three guys I listened to mostly at that time were Chick, who I met at Juilliard, and then Herbie [Hancock] and McCoy.
But were you not playing flute when you were with the Crusaders, or the Swingsters?
